tone.description: Chip colour, chosen from the badge palette.
tone.title: Tone

legend.description: One-line meaning, shown in the derived legend.
legend.title: Legend

label.description: Chip text for a one-off badge (not from the page vocabulary).
label.title: Label

tone.description: Chip colour from the badge palette.
tone.title: Tone

key.description: A key declared in the page `badges`.
key.title: Key

items.description: Chips: page-vocabulary refs or one-off label+tone pairs.
items.title: Items

tone.description: Accent + tint tone: info, success, warning, or danger.
tone.title: Tone

title.description: Optional bold title line in the tone colour.
title.title: Title

value.description: Headline number, or a short status string.
value.title: Value

tone.description: Optional tone for the top-border accent.
tone.title: Tone

delta.description: Optional trend chip beside the value (a period-over-period change).

note.description: Optional small caption line under the number.
note.title: Note

badges.description: Declared badge keys (from the page `badges`) to chip onto this card.
badges.title: Badges

label.description: Delta text shown beside the value, e.g. '+12%' or '0.3s'.
label.title: Label

direction.description: Optional glyph before the label: ▲ up, ▼ down, → flat.
direction.title: Direction

tone.description: Delta colour — YOU set it: up isn't always good (down is good for cost/errors), so skaldr never infers it. Omit for a neutral chip.
tone.title: Tone

variant.description: bar: compare a value across categories (grouped, or set stacked). line: a trend across an ordered axis (smoothed). donut: parts of a whole. Reach for a chart when a number's SHAPE (trend/spread/share) is the message; use `cards` for standalone figures and `meter` for a single ratio.
variant.title: Variant

title.description: Optional caption shown above the chart.
title.title: Title

categories.description: x-axis labels, left to right (bar/line only); each series has one value per category.
categories.title: Categories

series.description: One or more data series (bar/line only). Multiple series group side by side, or stack.
series.title: Series

slices.description: Donut segments (donut only); shares are derived from the total.
slices.title: Slices

stacked.description: Stack the bar series into one bar per category instead of grouping (bar only).
stacked.title: Stacked

label.description: Series name — shown in the legend.
label.title: Label

values.description: One value per category, in the same order as `categories`.
values.title: Values

tone.description: Optional tone for this series' bars/line.
tone.title: Tone

label.description: Slice name — shown in the legend.
label.title: Label

value.description: Slice magnitude (> 0); its share of the whole is derived.
value.title: Value

content.description: Code/log/config text; rendered verbatim, no highlighting.
content.title: Content

label.description: Optional label header above the block.
label.title: Label

mode.description: plain, or diff (+/- lines tinted success/danger).
mode.title: Mode

kind.description: text/rich (first one becomes the title column), number, badge (chip under title), or indicator (a colour-only dot in its own column; the cell value is a tone name).
kind.title: Kind

pct_of_total.description: Show a derived '% of total' caption (needs a reconcile total).
pct_of_total.title: Pct Of Total

width.description: Proportional width weight (1-6); set it on every non-badge column, or none.
width.title: Width

options.description: The things being compared — the column headers (2+).
options.title: Options

rows.description: Feature rows; each supplies one value per option.
rows.title: Rows

highlight.description: 0-based index of the recommended option column to emphasise.
highlight.title: Highlight

value.description: Cell text (for a ✓/✗ pass a bare true/false instead).
value.title: Value

feature.description: Row label — the attribute being compared.
feature.title: Feature

values.description: One cell per option, in column order.
values.title: Values

steps.description: Ordered stages (2+); a flow needs two or more nodes.
steps.title: Steps

style.description: arrow (default): short-labelled nodes joined by → connectors — reach for it when the DIRECTION between stages is the message (a pipeline or a data flow). steps: equal cards that each carry a caption line — reach for it when every stage needs a sentence of explanation.
style.title: Style

loop.description: Draw a '↺ back to <first>' return marker after the last node — for a cycle, not a one-way pipeline.
loop.title: Loop

numbered.description: Number the nodes 1..n (derived); set false to hide numbers.
numbered.title: Numbered

label.description: Short stage name — the node label.
label.title: Label

tone.description: Optional tone accent for this node's border + number.
tone.title: Tone

note.description: Optional one-line detail (rich text). Shown as the caption in `steps` style, and as a small sub-line in `arrow` style. If most nodes need a note, prefer style: steps.
note.title: Note

badges.description: Declared badge keys (from the page `badges`) to chip onto this node.
badges.title: Badges

blocks.description: Blocks stacked in the cell; may include nested grids (depth 2 max).
blocks.title: Blocks

tone.description: Optional tone: turns the cell into an emphasis panel (accent top-border + tint). Use `neutral` for a muted aside, `accent`/`success` for a primary panel.
tone.title: Tone

name.description: Group band label; shows the derived subtotal.
name.title: Name

label.description: Label for the non-issue bucket (e.g. 'Imported cleanly').
label.title: Label

value.description: Count in the bucket; added to the column sum for reconciliation.
value.title: Value

text.description: Heading text; also the TOC entry at level 2.
text.title: Text

src.description: A data: URI (self-contained — no external fetches). Base64-encode the payload (e.g. data:image/svg+xml;base64,...); a raw, unencoded SVG isn't a valid URI and won't render.
src.title: Src

caption.description: Optional caption shown below the image.
caption.title: Caption

blocks.description: Leaf blocks stacked in the cell.
blocks.title: Blocks

tone.description: Optional tone: turns the cell into an emphasis panel (accent top-border + tint). Use `neutral` for a muted aside, `accent`/`success` for a primary panel.
tone.title: Tone

date.description: Report date; feeds the footer (never auto-now).
date.title: Date

toc.description: Render a table of contents from level-2 headings.
toc.title: Toc

width.description: Page width cap: default (1600px), wide (1920px), or full (fill the window).
width.title: Width

hero.description: Opt-in hero header: a larger display title + subtitle in a tinted band, for a page that opens by selling an idea rather than a plain report header.
hero.title: Hero

max.description: Bar maximum (> 0); the denominator for the derived percentage.
max.title: Max

tone.description: Optional tone for the bar fill.
tone.title: Tone

total.description: Denominator; the column sum + handled must equal this.
total.title: Total

column.description: Key of the number column that must sum to `total`.
column.title: Column

title.description: Summary label shown on the collapsible.
title.title: Title

state.description: Step state, driving the glyph: done, pending, failed, blocked.
state.title: State

items.description: Steps/checks with a coloured state glyph.
items.title: Items

columns.description: Column specs; at least one text/rich column.
columns.title: Columns

groups.description: Grouped rows with derived subtotals; provide this OR `rows`, not both.
groups.title: Groups

rows.description: Ungrouped rows; provide this OR `groups`, not both.
rows.title: Rows

reconcile.description: Opt-in trust check on a number column.

totals.description: Sum a number column into a footer row.

body.description: Rich-text prose; blank lines split paragraphs.
body.title: Body

muted.description: Render in the caption colour, for asides.
muted.title: Muted

state.description: Optional dot state: done, current, pending.
state.title: State

badges.description: Declared badge keys (from the page `badges`) to chip onto this entry.
badges.title: Badges

column.description: Key of the number column to sum into a footer row.
column.title: Column
